[Religious Center]
A cul-de-sac dead-ends at the entrances of several temples. Robed clerics, monks, and templars with swords at their sides peruse the structures of their deities, easily conversing with members of their own temples. Members of temples with varying ideologies quickly pass by one another without so much as a nod.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, west, southwest, south, east, northeast, north

sw

[Travers Town Square]
Small marble benches are scattered neatly about the square welcoming travelers to take a seat or to possibly empty pebbles from their boots. Cobblestone streets decorate the square alternating from browns to reds in a random pattern. Small statues of the world's races stand behind each bench as if standing sentinel. Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans. Tucked away in a corner is an old door leading to a rundown store. The loud echoing of dripping water can be heard coming from a metal grate which is recessed into the street.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, south, southeast, east, northeast, north, closed grate, closed off-center wooden door

Nothing but gravestones covers the north as far as the eye can see, random in size and shape.  To the east peeking above the horizon a dark steeple stands solemn. A rotting fence which branches east and west stretches ominously into the distance.  A thunderous silence contaminates the air.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, west, south, east, northeast, north

ne
ne

[Graveyard]
Fresh grass begins to peak through a patch of charred earth. Small rectangular stones set into the ground,mark the resting places of a couple buried on either side of a heart shaped stone vase. Two dead roses blackened over time stand comfortably inside,their thorns missing.  Some large holes in the earth appear to be moist, possibly from the most recent rain.  

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, west, southwest, south, southeast, east, northeast, north


[Graveyard]
The door to the burnt temple lies on the ground next to the doorway. Burnt chuncks of wood lie scattered about the charred ground. Disturbed ground indicates recent activity and large and small footprints make their way through the exposed doorway.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: west, southwest, south, doorway

go door

[Foyer]
What remains of a large foyer lies burnt on the ground. Though full of holes left by the fire which overcame the large building, some roof still stands.  Burnt book pages and wood litters the blackened floor. Footprints left in the soot indicate recent visitors. The strong scent of fire resides throughout the whole area.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: south, southeast, east, doorway

s

[Burnt Temple]
Burnt walls lined by remnants of candle holders stand weekly on their burnt foundation. A small but charred table still stands against the western wall covered in ash. A small drawer slightly ajar displays melted wax of various colors which has run together. A book of some sort framed by a wax binding and cover which has melted its self to the small drawer can be seen.  Several rows of charred benches sit horizontally across the room. A large white silk curtain though burnt can be seen to the east, the symbol which it displays, is a bit too far away to identify.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: south, southeast, east, northeast, north

A lunatic cultist just entered the room right next to you.

A small podium stands in the center adorned with silver and gold and appears to be recently placed.

The area is illuminated.

Tall lamp posts with wrought iron lanterns look down on the neat and clean streets. An occasional waste engineer wanders through, sweeping up dirt and trash into tin dustpans.
